Hard water is one of the most common — and most overlooked — plumbing problems in Indiana homes. In this video, we break down 6 telltale signs that your home may have hard water, from chalky buildup on your faucets to scale damage inside your pipes and water heater.

If left untreated, hard water quietly shortens the life of your plumbing, your water heater, and your appliances. Know what to look for before it gets expensive.
